queue.alt: The actual CLI campaign queue shows calculated package findings, prices and required interventions alongside its conservative screen.
queue.caption: Each row carries the current native workflow into the desk. Unknown or blocked work remains separate from a supported correction.

imported.alt: The gift-kit SDK desk imports the exact calculated CLI workflow with its source receipts, findings and history.
imported.caption: The CLI-to-SDK continuation preserves the same native calculation; importing it creates no operating choice or authority.

evidence.alt: The exact-option Supporting report retains all failed conditions and their native requirement references.
evidence.caption: Inspect opens the selected candidate’s supporting details without changing inputs or recording a choice.

urgent.alt: With thirty minutes remaining, the $400 external complete correction finishes at minute 1,435; the cheaper complete correction is too late.
urgent.caption: The premium is justified by the actual cutoff. The fixed priority still prefers lower complete expense among eligible arrangements.

completed.alt: Linked sourced authorization, actual correction, a passed ten-minute rehearsal and complete handoff support the original gift-kit promise.
completed.caption: The separate actual-event gate checks the supplied records against the original quantity, configuration and cutoff.

failed.alt: A later failed rehearsal withdraws support for original handoff completion while retaining the earlier positive history.
failed.caption: The latest conflicting result supersedes the earlier positive. History remains inspectable.

pending.alt: Unapplied gift-kit form changes disable recalculation and withhold a current result until the inputs are applied.
pending.caption: A form draft is distinct from the applied calculation basis.

ample.alt: The SDK Decision summary prefers complete in-house correction at $300; the $400 external package also meets the one-day cutoff.
ample.caption: With the full day available, the cost-first profile supports the $300 complete correction.

overview.alt: With thirty minutes remaining, the $400 external complete correction finishes at minute 1,435; the cheaper complete correction is too late.
overview.caption: The premium is justified by the actual cutoff. The fixed priority still prefers lower complete expense among eligible arrangements.

process.alt: The authored gift-kit Decision process shows calculation, supported responses and separate operating completion.
process.caption: The same SDK output explains the available next response and the reassessment path.

dependencies.alt: Calculation dependencies show scoped evidence feeding the complete gift-kit correction assessment.
dependencies.caption: Calculation dependencies expose the native assessment handoffs; inspecting them performs no operating work.

staleBooking.alt: The urgent gift-kit context has no passing complete correction when the external booking covers the older insert.
staleBooking.caption: A fast quote cannot replace a booking that covers the exact configuration.

uncalculated.alt: The current gift-kit SDK desk has supplied inputs and asks for calculation before presenting a decision.
uncalculated.caption: Supplied inputs establish the calculation basis. The current finding appears after Calculate.

inputs.alt: Focused gift-kit forms show the current commitment, quotes and exact-configuration booking records.
inputs.caption: Apply inputs records the edited basis. Calculation and operating action remain separate.

changedBasis.alt: After applied gift-kit inputs change, the previous finding is marked stale and must be recalculated.
changedBasis.caption: A previously supported proposal does not remain current after its calculation basis changes.

recalculated.alt: The recalculated gift-kit Decision summary uses the new applied operating time and retains the assessment history.
recalculated.caption: Recalculate refreshes the connected assessments against the changed basis.

smaller.alt: The scoped diagnostic records support a $100 insert replacement rather than unnecessary complete journey repair.
smaller.caption: Different supported faults can justify a smaller complete correction under the same authored rules.
